properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.allow-comments
properties.description: Whether to allow parser to accept C/Java-style comments in JSON input.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.allow-special-floating-point-values
properties.description: Whether to remove the JSON specification restriction on special floating-point values such as 'NaN' and 'Infinity' and allow their serialization and deserialization as float literals without quotes.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.allow-structured-map-keys
properties.description: Whether to allow structured objects to be serialized as map keys by changing the serialized form of the map from JSON object (key-value pairs) to flat array like [k1, v1, k2, v2].

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.allow-trailing-comma
properties.description: Whether to allow parser to accept trailing commas in JSON objects and arrays.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.class-discriminator
properties.description: Name of the class descriptor property for polymorphic serialization.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.class-discriminator-mode
properties.description: Defines which classes and objects should have class discriminator added to the output.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.coerce-input-values
properties.description: Whether to coerce incorrect JSON values.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.decode-enums-case-insensitive
properties.description: Whether enum values are decoded in a case-insensitive manner.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.encode-defaults
properties.description: Whether default values of Kotlin properties should be encoded.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.explicit-nulls
properties.description: Whether null values should be encoded for nullable properties and must be present in JSON object during decoding.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.ignore-unknown-keys
properties.description: Whether encounters of unknown properties in the input JSON should be ignored instead of throwing SerializationException.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.lenient
properties.description: Whether parser should operate in lenient mode, removing the JSON specification restriction (RFC-4627) and being more liberal to malformed input.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.naming-strategy
properties.description: Specifies JsonNamingStrategy that should be used for all properties in classes for serialization and deserialization.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.pretty-print
properties.description: Whether resulting JSON should be pretty-printed.

properties.name: spring.kotlinx.serialization.json.use-alternative-names
properties.description: Whether Json instance makes use of JsonNames annotation.
